evidence.sentence: • We hallmark all our gold products to ensure quality and purity of products, which is in line with the quality and purity metrics as prescribed by BIS.
We send all our jewellery to governmentapproved hallmarking centers who perform tests and analyses our jewellery in accordance with BIS norms.

After the hallmark process is completed by the recognised hallmarking agencies in accordance with the prescribed BIS norms, we also process the same through our internal quality control checks to ensure authentication.
